about_the_game:
The Reality Show You Can Play!

Step into the spotlight and compete in the ultimate social strategy game inspired by reality TV competition shows. In Reality Rivals, you aren't the one watching the drama; you’re the one living it.

Form alliances, win challenges, and navigate betrayals as you fight to avoid exile. Every decision matters: who you trust, who you betray, and how you play the social game will shape your path to victory.

Key Features

  • 🏆 Be the House Captain (HC) – Compete in unique skill and stamina challenges to gain power and keep yourself safe.

  • 🤝 Dynamic Social Gameplay – Rivals remember your choices, from friendships to betrayals. Will you build trust… or burn bridges?

  • 🎭 Branching Dialogue & Choices – Each conversation offers multiple ways to influence your standing. Pick carefully—your words have weight.

  • 🔀 High Replay Value – Different playthroughs bring different alliances, targets, and outcomes. No two games are ever the same.

Can you outwit the competition to become the last Rival standing? The stage is set. The lights are on. Now it’s your move.
